name: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams
sku: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams only. Firehose, Managed Service for Apache Flink and Kinesis Video Streams are separate services and are not scored.

source.event-stream.note: Hosts continuous streams of records such as application logs, clickstream and market data feeds. Producers push records straight into a stream.

ingest.stream-ingest.note: Rapid, continuous intake with a typical put-to-get delay under one second, and several independent applications can consume the same stream at once. Processing is left to consumer applications you write.

bands.note: A stream's retention period is a native, per-stream setting: 24 hours by default, adjustable from 24 hours up to 365 days. A single retention lever, not the fuller residency or classification policy a governance platform manages.

presentation.tagline: Durable managed streams that decouple event producers from consumers.
